purpose: Preregister a morphology-only test at the historical frozen KUSTO target before inspecting live high-resolution seabed data.

gmrt_primary.reason: Masked ocean grids contain curated high-resolution data and NaN where such data do not exist.
gmrt_primary.admission: Morphology may run only on finite masked cells at the frozen target.

gebco_provenance.role: Independent provenance/coverage indicator only; never a substitute for resolving sonar morphology.
gebco_provenance.exact_tid_rule: A WMS measured-mask hit is not an exact TID code. Exact modality claims require TID NetCDF or equivalent authoritative source metadata.

metrics.prominence_snr: fixed-center inner elevation minus outer annulus median, divided by robust outer-annulus noise
metrics.radial_monotonicity: fraction of preregistered radial transitions whose median elevation does not increase away from the fixed center
metrics.fourfold_power_ratio: k=4 azimuthal harmonic power divided by summed k=1..8 harmonic power
metrics.orientation_stability_deg: modulo-90-degree phase disagreement of k=4 harmonic between inner and outer annuli

blind_controls.construction: 64 deterministic positions: 16 fixed azimuths on each of four rings at 10, 20, 30 and 40 km from the frozen point; no bathymetry-dependent selection.

independent_replication_rule: No morphology signal may be promoted to object identity without a second independently acquired resolving dataset with provenance and navigation/geometry sufficient to place the same feature on the seabed.
